fields.Name: TSK-00 - Task World
fields.Description: Commit the baseline Task World via BaseEntity subclasses: multi-domain categories, people, task types with unique codes, dynamic statuses, action hooks, and 3 divergent project hierarchies.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: 15+ Categories across 3 domains, 6 Task Types, Dynamic TaskTypeStatus records, Candidate Actions, 8 People, and 3 distinct Top-Level Projects with subtasks.
